newsitem.title: CANADA: Avenor sees C$100 mln Q4 gain.
newsitem.headline: Avenor sees C$100 mln Q4 gain.

text.p: Avenor Inc expects a gain of C$100 million or C$1.40 a share in the fourth quarter on the sale of its 53 percent stake in Pacific Forest Ltd, Chief Financial Officer Denis Aubin told Reuters on Wednesday.
"We are going to make an after-tax gain of about C$100 million," Aubin said in a telephone interview.
Aubin said net proceeds from the sale, which is expected to close in the fourth quarter, would be about C$300 million, most of which would be used to pay down debt.

Earlier on Wednesday, Avenor said it agreed to sell its stake in Pacific Forest to TimberWest Timber Trust for C$29 a share. TimberWest will then sell Pacific Forest's three sawmills and its crown woodland tenures to a unit of Doman Industries Ltd for about C$144 million.
